value.signature: fn cap_remaining (& mut self , remaining : u64) -> Result < () , Error >

exception.justification: Justified: This only narrows an operational cap; it admits no evidence or mathematical premise.

review.body: { if self . prepared . is_none () { return Err (Error :: Declaration) ; } self . procedure . maximum_work = self . procedure . maximum_work . min (self . budget . usage () . work . checked_add (remaining) . ok_or (Error :: Declaration) ?) ; let spent = self . budget . usage () . work ; let mut limits = self . budget . limits () . clone () ; limits . work = self . procedure . maximum_work ; let mut narrowed = Budget :: new (limits) ? ; narrowed . work (spent , Location :: new ("prepared retained Work prefix")) ? ; self . budget = narrowed ; Ok (()) }
review.item_premise: The prepared receiver retains only frozen public declarations and exact numerical requests, bounds, certificates and actual Work. New coordinate boxes are checked independently; reuse admits no secret, subscriber or publication bytes.
